prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was just thinking about that weekend in Shanghai—everyone kept debating restaurants like it was a sport.
Funny thing is, we ended up at this place called Chuanfu Laozao, and it was way better than the hype made it sound.
That dinner was on 2025-03-15, and somehow we all actually showed up on time for once.
They seated us right at 19:00, and it was a huge group—party size 9—so I’m still impressed they pulled it off.
I didn’t even book it myself—my friend Zhou Jun handled it, and he used 13851754018 for the contact.
Then a few days later I was backtracking from Beijing to Shanghai—my ticket was on MU5890, dated 2025-03-19.
That flight was under Li Na’s name, and earlier that same trip we’d stayed in Hangzhou at Home Inn West Lake—check-in was 2025-03-12 for 5 nights, booked under Zhang Wei.
